# Support

## Asking Questions

For questions about the series-RLC model, Octave compatibility shims, Python verification package, or IEEE report equations:

- Check [README.md](../README.md) and [docs/Soil_EC_Sensor_Design.pdf](../docs/Soil_EC_Sensor_Design.pdf) first.
- Open a [question issue](https://github.com/andrew-abdelmalak/soil-salinity-ec-sensor/issues/new?template=question.yml) if your question is not covered.

## Scope Limits

This repository is an academic course simulation and verification project for the ELCT 903 Sensor Technology course at the German University in Cairo. No physical sensor hardware is distributed or supported here.
